card.name: Small words before route of administration
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as a, an, as or you right after 'administer as' or 'given as', or 'medicines that', where a route or form (infusion, injection, put on the skin) comes next.

modes.label: Article after 'as'
modes.description: The word a or an after 'administer as' or 'given as', before a route or dose form.
modes.example: Administer as<< a>> subcutaneous injection once daily after the

modes.label: Medicines applied to skin
modes.description: The word 'you' in a phrase describing how a medicine is applied.
modes.example: Medicines (such as steroid creams) that<< you>> put on the skin

modes.label: 'such as' before routes
modes.description: The word 'as' in 'such as' ahead of a route or form.
modes.example: (such<< as>> oral tablets or local tissue injection)

card.writes: It pushes toward route words such as injection, spray and infusion-type terms, including Chinese equivalents.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before the text says how a drug is given, such as by injection or infusion.
